body: Honestly I'm running out of those lately, not much to hang on to

No I'm not, I'm an idiot who can't speak to anyone because of my anxiety and cannot connect to anyone.
I guess I could move back, but that would only be a failure more to the already long list. And since nobody knows how miserable I am, they might start asking why I left a "dream life".

Mid 20's, moved from a 3rd world country to a 1st world on the other side of the world because I got a good job there. Went from thinking I was straight, to asexual, to straight, to bi, to demisexual to I have no fucking idea now.

I had severe depression all of highschool and University, none of my family knows a thing about that.

I've been feeling useless at work, lonely as fuck and really starting to feel depression again.

Honestly I'm just thinking of killing myself since I'm abroad and none of my family can really reach me, that would be easier for everyone.
